transport.stock_email_node_rejected: Email Send v2.1 cannot set the persisted deterministic Message-ID

retryable_pre_acceptance.required_evidence: error proves failure before SMTP DATA acceptance

examples: timeout/socket close during or after DATA

retry_policy.spec_conflict_note: A 2h third retry would require a fourth provider submission and is not scheduled under the max-attempts=3 cap.

w13_normalization.authority: derive promised_asset from exact server-observed page_path; ignore client-provided asset identifiers
w13_normalization.request_id_policy: required; validated as a canonical RFC-4122 UUID v4 (version nibble 4, variant nibble in [89ab]); lowercased before use; missing or malformed values are rejected before insertion; never derived from email, name, page path, timestamp, IP, or user agent; not stored for cross-page tracking
w13_normalization.source_message_id: api_post:<request_id> (contains no email, name, page path, or other PII; deterministic for an exact replay; differs for distinct request_ids)
w13_normalization.ts_role: optional observational submission metadata only; never an idempotency key
w13_normalization.insert_mechanism: the W13 insert node calls the restricted database function public.mdg_w14_insert_lead (added by the 2026-07-28 R1 remediation migration); fulfillment_status is classified database-authoritatively by a BEFORE INSERT trigger, not by the caller
w13_normalization.replay_behavior: exact replay (same request_id AND same immutable request identity: normalized email, page_path, form_name, promised_asset, transport_kind) returns the existing lead id; no new row; no fulfillment-state change; no attempt
w13_normalization.mismatch_behavior: same request_id with different immutable request data fails closed with request_id_reuse_mismatch; no row created; no existing row mutated; the surrounding W13 workflow fails rather than returning a false successful lead response

activation_cutover.delivery: additive R1 remediation migration scripts/email/migrations/2026-07-28-w14-activation-cutover-request-id.sql, applied AFTER the immutable 2026-07-27 migration; independently idempotent; the July 27 file is not edited as the remediation mechanism
activation_cutover.initial_state: activation_cutover_at IS NULL; no lead is claimable for automatic fulfillment
activation_cutover.establish: public.mdg_w14_activate_cutover(operator, reason, cutover_at) — operator-only, transactional, idempotent; locks the singleton FOR UPDATE
activation_cutover.insert_race_safety: a BEFORE INSERT trigger (mdg_w14_classify_insert) reads the singleton FOR SHARE, which blocks behind mdg_w14_activate_cutover's FOR UPDATE lock; after the cutover commits, the trigger classifies the new row using the committed cutover and overrides any unsafe caller-supplied fulfillment_status (no asset / NULL cutover / received_at < cutover -> not_applicable; received_at >= cutover with an eligible asset -> pending)
activation_cutover.pre_cutover_rows: the R1 backfill sets every pre-remediation unattempted row not_applicable; all rows received before the cutover are not_applicable and never claimable
activation_cutover.post_cutover_rows: eligible promised-asset leads received at or after the cutover may become pending; non-asset leads remain not_applicable
activation_cutover.claim_defense_in_depth: mdg_w14_claim (superseded by R1, same signature) independently verifies the cutover and received_at >= activation_cutover_at; an incorrectly marked pre-cutover pending row is rejected
activation_cutover.non_destructive: rows already claimed, sending, fulfilled, manual_review, terminal, or with an existing attempt are never rewritten by cutover establishment or the R1 backfill
activation_cutover.privilege_exception: mdg_w14_classify_insert retains PUBLIC EXECUTE because a BEFORE INSERT trigger function must be executable by the inserting role; it can only classify the inserted row and cannot send email or mutate other rows. All state-changing functions are REVOKE'd FROM PUBLIC
activation_cutover.seven_day_proxy_remediated: the July 27 seven-day backfill proxy remains in the immutable historical migration (what production applied); the R1 remediation excludes every pre-remediation unattempted row regardless, so no pre-W14 row is auto-fulfillable after activation
activation_cutover.live_inventory_at_activation: operator must inventory the live queue and explicitly disposition any existing pending rows at the activation checkpoint (not part of the repository migration)
